title: atomic-design level map
description: The .atomic-design.json file at a repo's root. It records where each atomic level lives, which modules count as data, and how strict each rule is. Fields are only ever added, never renamed or removed; a missing field takes the default stated here.

levels.description: Globs per level. Atoms may point into a package or a themed UI-kit folder, for example packages/ui/src/** or src/shared/ui/mui/**.

pages.description: Glob for the route files. Default: none (pages are not checked).

dataModules.description: Module specifiers forbidden below containers, such as the server-state library, the router, the API client. A trailing * matches any subpath.

locales.description: Locales stories must render in. Default: [] (one locale, no switch).

defaultLocale.description: Default: the first entry of locales.

themes.description: Themes stories must render in. Default: [] (one theme).

tests.description: Commands the plugin runs, and how story tests run.

unit.description: Command for the unit suite, for example npx vitest run.

mode.description: How stories run as tests, chosen by setup and recorded here: vitest-addon (Vite with Vitest 4: every story in a real browser), test-runner (non-Vite builders: Storybook's test runner against the built Storybook) or portable (fallback: composeStories in jsdom, per locale x theme). No default; setup always writes it.

note.description: Why the recorded mode was chosen, for example 'portable: Vitest 3, upgrade declined; weaker than vitest-addon'. Setup writes it whenever the mode is not vitest-addon.

vitestProject.description: Name of the Vitest project that runs the story tests in vitest-addon mode. Default: storybook

upgradeDeclined.description: True when the team declined the Vitest 4 upgrade, so reruns do not ask again. Default: false

mcp.description: Whether the Storybook MCP server is wired. Default: false

stories.description: The story glob in .storybook/main. Default: all *.stories files under the components root.

version.description: The installed Storybook version when setup ran, as a note for later changes. Informational.

url.description: Where the published Storybook lives, without a trailing slash, used by the review's sign-off list to build story links. Default: http://localhost:6006 (the local dev port).

baseline.description: Path to the ratchet file of known violations. Default: .atomic-design-baseline.json

tokens.description: Where the design tokens live, written by the foundations command. Absent until foundations has run.

source.description: css-vars (custom properties in a stylesheet), tailwind (an @theme block or the Tailwind config) or theme-object (createTheme or a similar object).

path.description: The file or files that define the tokens, relative to the repo root. These files are exempt from the tokens-only rule.

grid.description: The spacing grid in pixels, 4 or 8. Documented in docs/foundations.md; never checked by a test.

exempt.description: Globs the tokens-only rule skips, for example **/icons/**. Each is reported in the README section for foundations.

export.description: theme-object only: the name of the exported theme in the file at path. Default: theme

i18n.description: Options of the i18n-no-hardcoded-strings rule. Absent: the library is checked, with the default attributes.

scope.description: library (atoms to templates) or app (the library plus containers and pages). Default: library.

attributes.description: JSX attributes whose string literals count as user-facing text. Replaces the default list: aria-label, title, placeholder, alt.

allow.description: Exact strings that may appear as they are, such as a brand name.

enabled.description: Whether the edit hook runs. Default: false. Setup writes true only when the developer opts in; the hook ignores a map without hook.enabled set to true.

team.description: Name of the team that owns the library. The component flow proposes it as a new component's owner. Default: none (the agent asks).

review.description: Thresholds for review advice, such as maxVariantProps (default 4). The component flow refuses a new variant at this count and proposes a separate component; review reports it as advice. Never fails a build.

chromatic.description: The Chromatic project or build URL the review's sign-off list links, for example https://www.chromatic.com/builds?appId=abc123. Default: none (no link). The plugin never sets Chromatic up.

rules.description: Severity per tested rule: error (fails the suite), warn (reported, does not fail) or off. Default: error for every tested rule. data-in-containers accepts only error.

data-in-containers.description: Only error is accepted. The rule can be relaxed only through the baseline, never switched off.
data-in-containers.x-error: data-in-containers can only be 'error'; it can be relaxed only through the baseline

a11y.description: Accessibility violations per story in vitest-addon mode. error fails the story test, warn reports it without failing, off skips it. Default: warn.

design.description: How components and visual changes are approved.

mode.description: figma, styleguide or code-first. Default: figma.

reviewer.description: The role or person who approves components and visual changes. Default: designer in figma and styleguide modes; must be named in code-first.

then.x-error: design.reviewer must be named when design.mode is code-first

matrix.description: Which locale x theme combinations are snapshotted. default: the default locale x every theme, plus the longest locale in the default theme. all: every combination. Default: default

viewports.description: Viewports to capture. desktop is 1280x800, mobile is 390x844. Default: [desktop]

lfsThresholdMb.description: Baselines larger than this many megabytes in total move to Git LFS (setup writes .gitattributes and says so). Default: 20
